generate_expansion: generate a Fourier expansion with circular or parallelogramic truncation for a given real-space lattice basis
reciprocal_lattice_vectors: compute the reciprocal lattice vectors from a pair of primitive real-space lattice vectors
transverse_wavevectors: compute all transverse wavevectors from a zeroth-order wavevector and a Fourier expansion
plane_wave_in_plane_wavevector: compute the in-plane wavevector for a plane-wave excitation given wavelength and angles
unit_cell_coordinates: compute coordinates within unit cells given primitive lattice vectors and grid shape
